protocol.loss: historical DARG loss plus SCMR auxiliary objectives
protocol.spectrum: train-only CAM240 PCA plus three-class between-class covariance; 16 orthonormal directions; whitening and class Gaussian statistics
protocol.classes: NC/MCI/AD retained as three conditional Gaussian classes
protocol.gaussian_banks: one all-outer-train bank plus five StratifiedKFold inner leave-bank banks, random_state=824250; comparison banks use the historical double-deletion moment reconstruction
protocol.prompts: canonical E82.4.6-G2 fixed eight-text medical and anonymous embeddings, SHA verified
protocol.gradient_budget: shared GFR, DARG, CAM and classification-head gradients use historical family-level tangent projection with a 0.001 norm budget; DPSL-only parameters use historical objective-family budgets
protocol.ema: train-only class mean/second-moment state updated after each epoch and checkpointed
protocol.abide_fold8: not copied; no patient overlap or ABIDE checkpoint is used
